Minor: seasonal caveat mentioned in truth but not in assistant answer; disclosure of May-2026 anchor present. Presentation clear, Hebrew business-focused, actionable.
answerSql:
WITH raw_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    l.PrtC AS prt,
    h.DateDoc AS d,
    (year(h.DateDoc) * 100 + month(h.DateDoc)) AS ym,
    l.Cmt AS qty,
    (l.Scm - l.VatAmount) AS net,
    CASE WHEN l.MivzaNo > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_promo
  FROM read_parquet('signedRoom://comaxDemo/usersRO/parquet/OEM_BI_4466/KupaDoc_Lines.parquet') l
  JOIN read_parquet('signedRoom://comaxDemo/usersRO/parquet/OEM_BI_4466/KupaDoc_Header.parquet') h ON l.KupaDocC = h.C
  WHERE h.DateDoc >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND l.Cmt > 0
),
im AS (
  SELECT 
    prt, 
    ym, 
    SUM(qty) AS qty, 
    SUM(net) AS net, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT d) AS nd, 
    MAX(is_promo) AS hp
  FROM raw_sales 
  GROUP BY prt, ym
),
pm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT prt FROM im WHERE ym = 202605 AND hp = 1
),
b AS (
  SELECT 
    im.prt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN im.ym = 202605 THEN im.qty ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN im.ym = 202605 THEN im.nd ELSE 0 END), 0) AS may_qpd,
    SUM(CASE WHEN im.ym = 202605 THEN im.net ELSE 0 END) AS may_net,
    SUM(CASE WHEN im.hp = 0 THEN im.qty ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN im.hp = 0 THEN im.nd ELSE 0 END), 0) AS base_qpd,
    SUM(CASE WHEN im.ym = 202605 THEN im.nd ELSE 0 END) AS may_nd,
    SUM(CASE WHEN im.hp = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bm
  FROM im 
  JOIN pm ON im.prt = pm.prt 
  GROUP BY im.prt
),
c AS (
  SELECT 
    *, 
    may_qpd / NULLIF(base_qpd, 0) AS ratio, 
    (may_qpd - base_qpd) * may_nd AS incremental_units
  FROM b 
  WHERE bm >= 2 AND base_qpd > 0
)
SELECT
  CASE 
    WHEN ratio >= 2 THEN '1. גידול חזק (פי 2 ומעלה)' 
    WHEN ratio >= 1.2 THEN '2. גידול מתון (1.2 עד 2)'
    WHEN ratio >= 0.9 THEN '3. ללא שינוי (0.9 עד 1.2)' 
    ELSE '4. ירידה בכמות (מתחת ל-0.9)' 
  END AS tier,
  COUNT(*) AS items, 
  ROUND(SUM(may_net) / 1000.0, 1) AS may_net_K,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(may_net) / SUM(SUM(may_net)) OVER(), 1) AS net_share_pct,
  ROUND(MEDIAN(ratio), 2) AS median_ratio, 
  ROUND(SUM(incremental_units) / 1000.0, 1) AS incr_units_K
FROM c 
GROUP BY tier 
ORDER BY tier ASC

WITH coh AS (
  SELECT C AS prt, DateOpen,
    CASE 
      WHEN DateOpen >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND DateOpen < DATE '2026-04-01' THEN 'recent_2026Q1'
      WHEN DateOpen >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND DateOpen < DATE '2025-04-01' THEN 'hist_2025Q1' 
    END AS coh_group
  FROM read_parquet('signedRoom://comaxDemo/usersRO/parquet/OEM_BI_4466/Prt.parquet')
  WHERE DepartmentC NOT IN (164, 204)
    AND ((DateOpen >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND DateOpen < DATE '2026-04-01')
      OR (DateOpen >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND DateOpen < DATE '2025-04-01'))
),
w13 AS (
  SELECT c.coh_group, c.prt, SUM(l.Scm - l.VatAmount) AS net13
  FROM coh c 
  JOIN read_parquet('signedRoom://comaxDemo/usersRO/parquet/OEM_BI_4466/KupaDoc_Lines.parquet') l ON l.PrtC = c.prt
  JOIN read_parquet('signedRoom://comaxDemo/usersRO/parquet/OEM_BI_4466/KupaDoc_Header.parquet') h ON l.KupaDocC = h.C
  WHERE h.DateDoc >= c.DateOpen AND h.DateDoc < c.DateOpen + INTERVAL '13 weeks'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT 
  c.coh_group AS cohort, 
  COUNT(*) AS items_opened, 
  COUNT(w.prt) AS items_with_sales,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(w.prt) / COUNT(*), 0) AS pct_activated,
  ROUND(MEDIAN(COALESCE(w.net13, 0)), 0) AS median_net_13wk,
  ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(w.net13, 0)), 0) AS mean_net_13wk
FROM coh c 
LEFT JOIN w13 w ON c.prt = w.prt AND c.coh_group = w.coh_group
GROUP BY 1 
ORDER BY 1 DESC

### ניתוח חריגות קופאים וזיכויים

מניתוח הנתונים עולה כי קיימים מספר קופאים המציגים חריגה משמעותית ושיעורי זיכויים והנחות הגבוהים משמעותית מחציון הסניף שבו הם פועלים:

WITH branch_sales AS (
        SELECT 
          h.StoreC,
          SUM(h.Scm - h.ScmMaam) AS net_sales,
          COUNT(DISTINCT h.C) AS transactions,
          SUM(h.Scm - h.ScmMaam) / COUNT(DISTINCT h.C) AS avg_basket

        WHERE h.DateDoc >= DATE '2024-01-01'
        GROUP BY h.StoreC
      ),
      branch_cost AS (
        SELECT 
          h.StoreC,
          SUM((l.Scm - l.VatAmount) - ic.unit_cost * l.Cmt) AS gross_profit,
          SUM(l.Scm - l.VatAmount) AS costed_net_sales
        FROM read_parquet('signedRoom://comaxDemo/usersRO/parquet/OEM_BI_4466/KupaDoc_Lines.parquet') l
        JOIN read_parquet('signedRoom://comaxDemo/usersRO/parquet/OEM_BI_4466/KupaDoc_Header.parquet') h ON l.KupaDocC = h.C
        LEFT JOIN (
          SELECT StoreID, ItemID, arg_max(FinalRegularCostPrice, DateDoc) AS unit_cost
